GRBM_findings.GRBM_reduction: Custom aliases reduce(GRBM_COUNT,max) and reduce(GRBM_GUI_ACTIVE,max) match installedSDK expressions; parse_counters preserves scalarmax and does notsum itagain. Raw GRBM instance values are absent from this scalarCSV, so per-XCC dimensionality cannotbe independentlychecked here.
GRBM_findings.MFMA_formula: 100*sum(SQ_VALU_MFMA_BUSY_CYCLES)/(max(GRBM_GUI_ACTIVE)*1024) matches installedMfmaUtil; arithmetic validity doesnot establish same-clock/same-walltime denominator.
GRBM_findings.clock_window_limit: All4collections have GRBM_COUNT/duration_ns abovetheGPU Max_Engine_Clk_Fcompute2400MHz. GRBM_COUNT=GUI_ACTIVE in every selectedsample. No fixedfactor correction or absoluteutilization/occupancy boundclassification is justified bythese samples.
GRBM_findings.SQ_units: SQ_WAVE_CYCLES/WAIT_ANY/WAIT_INST_ANY/ACTIVE_INST_ANY arequadcycles; meanlife4*wavecycles/waves and matchedsum ratios areinternallyconsistent. SQ_BUSY_CYCLES isper-SE clockcycle, notquadwavecycles.
GRBM_findings.MFMA_busy_operations: Inall4collections, F8ops counterisexact2MNK/512 andMFMA_BUSY isexactonequarterthatcounter. Thisisconsistent with32busy-countunits perscaled16x16x128MFMA and128F8countunits perMFMA; independentpipeline-saturation information islimited.

GRBM_factor_conclusion: SDKdescription只给GRBM TieHigh clocks和installedmaxformula；现有CSV均为scalar reductions，没有rawGRBM维度或SDK packet校准证据，不支持推断乘法因素，更不自动纠正。
